description: Verify an AI answer against real sources before anyone acts on it. Send a question; Oathlayer answers it, checks the answer against independent sources, and returns the answer, a state, a plain-language message (the tag), a color, and a permanent doc number anyone can verify free at oathlayer.com/verify. Tags: Verification Successful - Oath Approved (green); Verification Threshold Not Met (blue); Various Perspectives Apply (purple); Complex Question - Threshold Reserved; Clarity Needed to Continue (pink). Legal citations also get a citation tag: confirmed on official sources (green), found only on unofficial sites (blue), mismatched with the correct citation shown (coral), or not found in available sources (golden brown). Citation answers also include a short label: Confirmed, Unofficial, Mismatched or Not found. Oathlayer reports what happened; it does not judge right or wrong. Works on any topic and with any AI model. Costs one credit per completed check; errors and wrong keys cost nothing. Requires an API key from oathlayer.com.

apiKey.description: Your Oathlayer API key from oathlayer.com. Each completed check uses one credit.

question.description: The question to verify, in plain words (for a legal citation, include the full case name and citation). Spanish questions are supported.
